title: Ossie values/search and schema sample values honour saiku.roles field allow/deny and row predicates

criteria.given: a caller whose roles deny (or do not allow) an Ossie field calls GET /ai/ossie/values/search for it
criteria.then: searchValues resolves the field from the role-filtered model (OssieRoleContext.filterHidden), so a denied field is refused as unknown instead of enumerated

criteria.given: a dataset declares row_predicates for the caller's role
criteria.then: the values-search SQL and the schema sample-value SQL are both ANDed with the caller's combined role predicate (OssieRoleContext.combinedRowPredicateFor), so values from hidden rows are never returned

criteria.given: two callers with different row scopes request the schema for the same model
criteria.then: the sample cache is scoped by the row predicate, so one caller's samples are never served to another
it filters the semantic model by the caller's roles and passes the roles to the projector, so denied fields and their samples never reach the prompt
tests ship for role-scoped combined predicates, row-scoped samples with cache isolation, and the scoped values-search SQL
